purpose: Teach: 現われる/送れる/盛り上げる/おのずと/歩き回っ/さらい/か所/ソクラテス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さんの夢、絶対、現われる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、よくあったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When we were young, your father used to have those dreams so often — the ones that would just appear out of nowhere in a moment. I remember it so clearly.
lines.style: Soft, searching tone. Reaches back into memory with gentleness. Slight pause before speaking, as if watching the past unfold in real time. Voice carries the warmth of recollection without urgency.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、ばあさんに、絶対、手紙を、絶対、送れる、絶対、機会、絶対、嬉しかったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. When we were young, your father used to send me letters whenever he got the chance — and I was always so happy to receive them. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, immediate recognition. Brightens slightly on the mention of the letters. Gentle cadence that moves unhurried. Soft affection woven through each phrase, like speaking of something precious being held carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、宴会を、絶対、盛り上げる、絶対、のが、絶対、得意だったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father was so good at bringing a party to life back then, Gran. Do you remember? He had such a gift for it.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia with a hint of admiration in the voice. Slight lift on 'bringing a party to life' — almost gentle pride. Pace is measured, allowing the memory space to breathe.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、努力を続けていれば、絶対、おのずと、絶対、道が、絶対、開けるって、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、言っていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: That's right. Your grandfather used to say that if you keep putting in the effort, the path opens up on its own. You remember him saying that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement. Voice settles on the wisdom being quoted, giving it weight. Gentle rhythm that feels like she's confirming something they both know to be true. Soft close on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、町を、絶対、歩き回って、絶対、お父さん、絶対、商談、絶対、まとめてきたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father used to walk all over town making deals, tying everything together. Do you remember that, Gran?
lines.style: Pride mixed with quiet admiration. Slight forward momentum in the pacing. Voice carries the image of purposeful movement. Lands gently on the question, inviting her to confirm the shared memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、お料理の、絶対、おさらい、絶対、よくしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: And I was always practicing my cooking, reviewing my recipes over and over. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm self-acknowledgment without self-consciousness. Gentle humor in the voice — the affectionate memory of her own dedication. Pace is easy, almost conversational. Soft warmth on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、家の、絶対、三か所、絶対、お父さん、絶対、修繕したぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Your father fixed three different parts of the house back then. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. Quiet pride in the accomplishment. Voice lands firmly on the work he did, then softens into the question. Pace is steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ソクラテス、絶対、の本、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、読んでいたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: That's true. Your grandfather was always reading Socrates back then. You remember him doing that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft affirmation tinged with wonder. Voice carries quiet respect for the intellectual curiosity being recalled. Gentle, unhurried pacing. Closes with genuine warmth and connection in 'dear.'
